name: Crypto Price Scroller
author: Airdrop Army

sections.description:
Showcase live cryptocurrency prices in a sleek, scrolling ticker. Perfect for crypto traders, bloggers, and websites that want to keep their audience updated with real-time market data. The plugin displays the top cryptocurrencies by market capitalization (excluding stablecoins), using reliable data from CoinGecko.

Users can select the display currency for prices, choosing from popular options such as USD ($), EUR (€), GBP (£), JPY (¥), and more. Customize your ticker to match your audience’s preferences!

Just add the shortcode [crypto_price_scroller], and the ticker will display live prices automatically. For best performance, place the scrolling ticker in a full-width block of your template.

Live Preview↗️

Plugin Performance
The plugin is lightweight, optimized for performance, and doesn’t impact your website speed or SEO. It fetches data dynamically from CoinGecko, ensuring accurate and up-to-date prices with minimal server load.

Usage

To display the Crypto Price Scroller:
1. Add the shortcode [crypto_price_scroller] to your website.
2. Use the plugin’s settings to select the display currency, such as USD, EUR, GBP, and more.
3. Place the scrolling ticker in a full-width block of your template for the best visual and performance results.
4. Save and preview your content to see the scrolling crypto price ticker in action.

External Services

This plugin fetches real-time cryptocurrency price data from CoinGecko’s API to display the top cryptocurrencies by market capitalization, excluding stablecoins.

Details about the data usage:
– What the service is and what it is used for:
The CoinGecko API provides real-time cryptocurrency price data for the ticker display.

  • What data is sent and when:
    This plugin does not send any data or require any API key. It fetches public market data directly from CoinGecko.

  • Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:
    The CoinGecko API service is provided by CoinGecko. You can review their Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the crypto-price-scroller folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Add the [crypto_price_scroller] shortcode to display the ticker.
sections.faq:
How do I use this plugin?

To display the Crypto Price Scroller on your website, add the shortcode [crypto_price_scroller]. For best performance, place the ticker in a full-width block of your template.

Which cryptocurrencies are displayed?

The ticker shows the top 20 cryptocurrencies by market capitalization, excluding stablecoins. Data is updated in real-time using the CoinGecko API.

Can I change the currency in which prices are displayed?

Yes! The plugin allows you to select the currency for price display. You can choose from the following:
– United States Dollar (USD, $)
– Euro (EUR, €)
– British Pound (GBP, £)
– Japanese Yen (JPY, ¥)
– Australian Dollar (AUD, A$)
– Canadian Dollar (CAD, C$)
– Swiss Franc (CHF, ₣)
– Chinese Yuan (CNY, ¥)
– Hong Kong Dollar (HKD, HK$)
– New Zealand Dollar (NZD, NZ$)
– Singapore Dollar (SGD, S$)
– Swedish Krona (SEK, kr)
– Norwegian Krone (NOK, kr)
– Danish Krone (DKK, kr)
– Indian Rupee (INR, ₹)
– South Korean Won (KRW, ₩)
– Brazilian Real (BRL, R$)
– South African Rand (ZAR, R)
– Mexican Peso (MXN, Mex$)
– Russian Ruble (RUB, ₽)

How often is data updated?

The plugin caches prices from CoinGecko for 3 minutes to minimize API usage and ensure efficient performance.

The ticker isn’t displaying correctly. What should I do?

Ensure your WordPress installation is up-to-date and that your site can access external APIs.
